name: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz
title: The Prophet's Symbolic Son
summary: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz was the second son of the prophet Isaiah. His name, meaning 'Swift to the plunder, quick to the spoil,' served as a prophetic sign that Assyria would soon plunder both Damascus and Samaria. The child's birth and naming acted as a divine confirmation of God's judgment against Syria and Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Prophecy of the Birth
keyEvents.description: The Lord commanded Isaiah to write the name 'Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz' on a large tablet with clear handwriting, as a witness to the coming judgment.

keyEvents.title: The Birth Confirms the Prophecy
keyEvents.description: The prophetess (Isaiah's wife) became pregnant and gave birth to a son. The Lord commanded that he be named Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

keyEvents.title: The Prophetic Meaning of the Name
keyEvents.description: Before the boy could say 'father' or 'mother,' the wealth of Damascus and the spoil from Samaria would be carried away to the king of Assyria.

keyEvents.title: Part of Isaiah's Prophetic Signs
keyEvents.description: Together with his brother Shear-Jashub, Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz was a living sign and wonder in Israel from the Lord, God of hosts.
